sources: Esri World_Imagery with the rec.gov per-site points

values.note: 19 large sites in a flat, open meadow strung along the access road beside Williams Creek for about 1 km (rec.gov site points 01-19). Equipment must fit in the parking spur; no overflow parking. Up to 8 people per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/bridge-campground ('Bridge Campground offers 19 campsites in a flat, open area all on a first-come, first-serve basis'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available.'; 'Max RV size = 35 ft'; 'Maximum number of people per site: 8') + recreation.gov per-site points for 10165180, read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/bridge-campground ('Vault Toilet (3)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: May through September; recreation.gov's first-come season for 2026 ran May 8 - Sept 12 (2027 listed June 5 - Sept 12).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/bridge-campground ('Seasons of Use: May through September. For specific open / closure dates, visit recreation.gov.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165180/rates ('First-come, First-served Season' 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-12; 2027-06-05 to 2027-09-12), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come, first-served only: arrive in person to claim a site, then pay on site, where available by Scan and Pay in the Recreation.gov app (download it beforehand; little or no cell service). Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon (any time if the site is empty). Generators no more than an hour at a time; quiet 10 p.m. - 6 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/bridge-campground ('All 19 sites are first come, first serve.'; 'Check-in time: 2:00 pm / Check-out time: 12:00 pm / If the site is empty, campers may come in anytime.'; generator and quiet-time rules) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165180 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site ... Scan and Pay feature'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/bridge-campground ('Single Site: $28 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165180/rates (2026 and 2027 First-come, First-served Season: ScanPay 1 $28), read 2026-10-28

note: San Juan NF (Pagosa RD) campground in a flat, open meadow beside Williams Creek, ~18 mi NW of Pagosa Springs via Piedra Road (FR 631, gravel, open year-round and suitable for most vehicles). Large sites with views of the high peaks to the north. No horses in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 10165180: confirmed 19 FCFS sites, vault toilets, potable water, $28 (2027 same), not reservable (Scan and Pay). Added max_rig_ft 35 (FS 'Max RV size = 35 ft'), season note (May-September; rec.gov 2026 FCFS season May 8 - Sept 12), booking note. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Missing phone: Pagosa Ranger District (970) 264-2268 (FS page contact). recreation.gov's facility contact is a concessionaire: (661) 702-1420, rlynd@goexplorus.com (Explorus). Ownership federal stands.

Riverview (stored) - possible riverfront lead, waterfront not changed: the campground is a ~1 km string of sites along the road on Williams Creek's west bank; on imagery some sites (05 at the south end, 13 at the north end) sit ~25-35 m from the creek across open meadow with only scattered willow, while the middle sites (07-12) are ~50-90 m back.

Pin 37.46498,-107.19687 is at sites 02-03 / the Scan and Pay point at the south end; the centroid of the 18 catalogued site points (37.46878,-107.19895) is ~460 m north, because the sites run ~1 km up the creek (site 19 at 37.47329). Under 500 m; the pin is on the campground.
FS page oddity: 'Picnic tables are not available at this site.' Nothing recorded from it.
Status: 'Site Closed' badge on the FS page today, consistent with the May-September season; Piedra Road 'open year-round'.
